_help: One entry per project. Rebuild with python3 tools/build.py after editing: the build renders the cards into the home, work and service pages.
An item is shown only when publish and rightsConfirmed are both true and it passes validation; anything refused is printed by the build.
Fields: slug, title, service (video-ads, ugc-content, websites, marketing, documents-decks), client (name or null), concept (true for self-initiated work),
conceptNotice (optional; defaults to 'Self-initiated concept — not commissioned by the featured brand.'), brief, contribution (what SPY-D actually did),
poster (path under assets/media/work/ or an https URL), posterAlt, posterWidth, posterHeight, posterSrcset (optional list of [path, width]), focalPoint (CSS object-position),
mediaType (image, youtube or video), id (YouTube ID for youtube), videoSrc (for video), viewUrl (optional https link for image items), format (e.g. 9:16 · 30s),
vertical (true for portrait work), featured (true to show on the home page, up to three), outcome (only verified, owner-supplied text), publish, rightsConfirmed.
